description: A route that works and will not survive a restart. The route IS usable — it is in memory and the next `ask` will use it — so this is NOT a provider failure and must not send anybody to check their API key. What failed is durability: a full disk, a permission on the state directory, a closed store. `fatal: false`, because the person can carry on; what they must not do is restart believing it was saved.

data.what: route "anthropic" is usable now but was not saved: write the credential for route "anthropic": open /home/p/.local/state/aeon/credentials/anthropic.key: permission denied
data.means: the route works until the daemon restarts; the configuration is in memory and the credential may not have been filed. This is a disk or permission problem, not a problem with the route or the provider
data.todo: check `aeon db info` for the store path, and that the state directory is writable — then set the route again
